key_point: Dragon Quest made kids skip school
title: Dragon Quest made kids skip school
caption: When Dragon Quest III launched in 1988, police got involved. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #dragonquest #enix

instagram.caption:
Dragon Quest III launched in Japan on a Wednesday in February 1988, and the lines were huge.

Reports say nearly 300 students were taken in for truancy after skipping class to buy it, and the police contacted Enix.

Enix chose to release later games on weekends. There was never a law, despite the myth. Fans were simply that devoted.

Have you ever skipped something for a game launch?
